description: A read-only snapshot of the reproducibility ledger produced by building this demo cache: one entry per recorded precomputed run, with the full record (configuration, hash, versions, terminal metrics). Run ids, timestamps and file paths are normalised. Artifact downloads are not available in the demo. Precomputed example run of the Telomere Lab model with fixed seeds -- not patient data and not a prediction. Illustrative model behaviour only; see the Scientific scope page.
title: Example experiment ledger
